Settings.Name: Enable item destruction
Settings.Description: If disabled, this mod will not destroy any items on death.

Settings.Name: Affect who?
Settings.Description: Choose whether item destruction applies only to the player party or to every character.

Settings.Name: Stack per extra overkill step
Settings.Description: If enabled, additional extra damage beyond the first overkill step destroys additional random items.

Settings.Name: Legendaries are immune
Settings.Description: If enabled, Legendary items are never destroyed.

Settings.Name: Adamantine items are immune
Settings.Description: If enabled, Adamantine items are never destroyed.

Settings.Name: Ash-body deaths destroy equipped items
Settings.Description: If enabled, petrify-shatter and disintegrate ash-body deaths destroy all equipped items when the hidden Raise Dead block is applied.

Settings.Name: Disintegrate save breaks one item
Settings.Description: If enabled, succeeding on a Disintegrate save destroys one random non-immune equipped item.

Settings.Name: Empty slots grant initiative
Settings.Description: If enabled, player characters and humanoids gain +1 initiative for each empty weapon slot, empty main armor slot, empty helmet slot, and empty cloak slot. Two-handed melee weapons and bows count as using both relevant weapon slots.

Settings.Name: On hit equipment failure
Settings.Description: Percent chance that a positive hit can destroy one eligible equipped item after the Dexterity save.

Settings.Name: On crit equipment failure
Settings.Description: Percent chance that a critical hit can separately destroy one eligible equipped item after the Dexterity save.

Settings.Name: Downed equipment failure
Settings.Description: Percent chance that becoming downed can destroy one eligible equipped item after the Dexterity save.

Settings.Name: Equipment failure save DC
Settings.Description: On-hit, crit, and downed destruction use Dexterity. Burning and Acid condition destruction use the better of Dexterity or Constitution.

Settings.Name: Condition saves have advantage
Settings.Description: If enabled, Burning and Acid condition item destruction rolls twice and keeps the better result. This applies to players and enemies according to the Affect who setting.

Settings.Name: Bludgeoning chunking / corpse explosion
Settings.Description: If enabled, lethal Bludgeoning hits that meet the Bludgeoning chunking threshold remove Overkill_Exploder and trigger the corpse explosion / chunking effect.

Settings.Name: Bludgeoning chunking threshold
Settings.Description: If a lethal Bludgeoning hit deals at least this much damage, Overkill_Exploder is removed and the corpse explosion / chunking effect triggers.

Settings.Name: Force chunking / corpse explosion
Settings.Description: If enabled, lethal Force hits that meet the Force chunking threshold remove Overkill_Exploder and trigger the corpse explosion / chunking effect.

Settings.Name: Force chunking threshold
Settings.Description: If a lethal Force hit deals at least this much damage, Overkill_Exploder is removed and the corpse explosion / chunking effect triggers.

Settings.Name: Thunder chunking / corpse explosion
Settings.Description: If enabled, lethal Thunder hits that meet the Thunder chunking threshold remove Overkill_Exploder and trigger the corpse explosion / chunking effect.

Settings.Name: Thunder chunking threshold
Settings.Description: If a lethal Thunder hit deals at least this much damage, Overkill_Exploder is removed and the corpse explosion / chunking effect triggers.

Settings.Name: Elemental permadeath mode
Settings.Description: Controls Fire, Acid, Lightning, Cold, Radiant, and Necrotic deaths. 'death' applies the Raise Dead block on any positive killing hit of those types. 'overkill' requires the killing hit's overkill to meet the threshold below. 'none' disables this automatic permadeath rule.

Settings.Name: Elemental permadeath overkill threshold
Settings.Description: Used only when elemental permadeath mode is set to 'overkill'. Zero-damage hits never apply elemental permadeath. Values of 0 or less are treated as 1.

Settings.Name: Immune item StatNames (text)
Settings.Description: Enter item StatNames immune to destruction, separated by spaces or commas.
